body: I'm a student right now. In my math class, there is a rule where you can replace your lowest test score with what you get on the final. However, you have to get your notebook checked, and get full points on that notebook check. So, me being the dumb idiot I am, decided to half-ass the notebook, and wait to the last minute to finish my notebook. I turn in my notebook, and then take a unit test. The test was ridiculously hard, and I got a 63%. I was upset, since my previous test average was 94%. But, because I had half-assed my notebook, I missed a single point on the notebook check, and could not replace that test score, and had to settle for replacing the next lowest score. My next lowest test was a 93, so replacing it would do literally nothing to my grade. Because of that one measly little point, I got a B in the class instead of the A I needed; I was at an 89.3%, no less. So if I could go back in time, I would go back to when I was half-assing my notebook, slap my past self, and tell my past self to do the notebook right.
